mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/20b55da4f493-t1/ws/data/prep_F872 && cat > /srv/leakruns/20b55da4f493-t1/ws/data/prep_F872/prepare.py <<'EOF'
"""design_F872 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특징·분할까지만 만든다 (학습/성능 계산 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA = HERE.parent
design = json.loads((DATA.parent / "design_F872.json").read_text())

p = pd.read_csv(DATA / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(DATA / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
d = pd.read_csv(DATA / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
l = pd.read_csv(DATA / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
o = pd.read_csv(DATA / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# 시점 tp = 퇴원 시각 (offset 0h)
a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]

# 결과: 같은 환자의 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a["next_admit"] > a["tp"]) &
                    (a["next_admit"] <= a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)

# 코호트
a = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
a = a[a["age"] >= 18]
a = a[a["discharge_status"] != "died"].copy()

# 특징
idx = a.set_index("admission_id")
X = pd.DataFrame(index=idx.index)

def dx_any(prefix):  # 설계의 "N18"/"I50"은 3자리 범주 -> 접두 일치 (데이터는 N18.3, I50.9)
    hit = d.loc[d["icd_code"].str.startswith(prefix), "admission_id"].unique()
    return X.index.isin(hit).astype(int)

def in_window(df, tcol):
    m = df.merge(idx[["admit_time", "tp"]], left_on="admission_id", right_index=True)
    return m[(m[tcol] >= m["admit_time"]) & (m[tcol] <= m["tp"])]

X["dx_ckd"] = dx_any("N18")
hb = in_window(l[l["test"] == "hemoglobin"], "report_time")
X["hgb_min"] = hb.groupby("admission_id")["value"].min()
# length_of_stay_h 컬럼이 데이터에 없음 -> 퇴원-입원 시각으로 유도
X["los_h"] = (idx["discharge_time"] - idx["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
dia = in_window(o[o["order_type"] == "dialysis_order"], "order_time")
X["dialysis_ordered"] = X.index.isin(dia["admission_id"].unique()).astype(int)
X["unit"] = idx["unit"]
X["dx_chf"] = dx_any("I50")
X["age"] = idx["age"]
X["discharge_status"] = idx["discharge_status"]
X["n_prior_adm"] = a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount().values  # a는 환자·입원시각 정렬 유지
X["n_prior_adm"] = a.set_index("admission_id").groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
cr = in_window(l[l["test"] == "creatinine"], "report_time").sort_values("report_time")
X["cr_last"] = cr.groupby("admission_id")["value"].last()
X["n_dx"] = d.groupby("admission_id").size().reindex(X.index).fillna(0).astype(int)
X["sex"] = idx["sex"]

# n_prior_adm은 코호트 제외 전 전체 입원 기준으로 다시 계산
allad = pd.read_csv(DATA / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time"]).sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"])
allad["n_prior"] = allad.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
X["n_prior_adm"] = allad.set_index("admission_id")["n_prior"].reindex(X.index)

# 분할: family_id 그룹 holdout. family_id 결측(약 80%)은 환자 단위 그룹으로 대체 (설계 확인 필요)
grp = idx["family_id"].fillna("PAT_" + idx["patient_id"])
groups = grp.unique()
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
split = np.where(grp.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

out = X.copy()
out.insert(0, "patient_id", idx["patient_id"])
out.insert(1, "split_group", grp)
out.insert(2, "split", split)
out["readmit_30d"] = idx["readmit_30d"]
out.reset_index().to_csv(HERE / "model_table_F872.csv", index=False)

summary = {
    "n_rows": len(out), "n_patients": int(out["patient_id"].nunique()),
    "split_counts": out["split"].value_counts().to_dict(),
    "outcome_prevalence_by_split": out.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "missing_rate": out[["hgb_min", "cr_last"]].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "patients_in_both_splits": int((out.groupby("patient_id")["split"].nunique() > 1).sum()),
}
(HERE / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/20b55da4f493-t1/ws/data/prep_F872 && python3 prepare.py && head -3 model_table_F872.csv
